items.name: colorfindr
items.what_it_is: Extracts colors from various image types, plots treemaps and 3D scatterplots of color compositions, create color palettes.

feature_lines:
colorfindr
This R package allows you to extract colors from various image types (currently JPEG, PNG, TIFF, SVG, BMP).
Either a tailored report (directly with the main function getcolors), a treemap (plotcolors) or a 3D scatterplot (plotcolors3d) with the image color composition can be returned.
Version 0.1.4 provides several methods for creating discrete color palettes.

Installation
Version 0.1.6 is on CRAN and can be installed as follows:
r
install.packages("colorfindr")
